title: VortyLib
description: Minecraft library with shared features for my mods
body:
VortyLib is a simple library mod with shared features for most of my mods

## Current Features
- Custom RenderTypes with core shaders
- Iris Shaders support for custom RenderTypes
- Custom Font class for rendering text without culling

## Planned Features
- Extended Iris Shaders support
- Extended GuiGraphics
